#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the already downloaded registry archive; no registry writes."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ARCHIVE_SHA = "6d555d955c3734dd5ee78f7173569bdecd4426095b2ffedc4b77d8f0f2c2e8d9"
COMMIT = "4f65dc48686a3b701ed0585812fcca46859f7e5a"
ARCHIVE = ROOT / ".local/artifacts/scm-sdk-0.1.0-registry-6d555d955c3734dd.crate"
OUTPUT = ROOT / ".local/checks/release-registry-execution-0.1.0.json"


def main():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("package_checks", ROOT / "scripts/check-package.py")
    checks = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(checks)
    content = ARCHIVE.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != ARCHIVE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Registry archive checksum changed")
    files = checks.inspect_archive(content, "scm-sdk-0.1.0/")
    vcs = checks.validate_vcs(files, COMMIT, True)
    environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
                   if not k.startswith(("PANW_", "AIRS_", "SCM_")) and
                   k not in ("FORGEJO_TOKEN", "CDOT_ENV_FORGEJO_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN")}
    environment["CARGO_TERM_COLOR"] = "never"
    environment["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(ROOT / ".local/registry-execution-target")
    cargo = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cargo/bin/cargo"
    rustc = cargo.with_name("rustc")
    report = {
        "schemaVersion": 1,
        "checkedAt": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "package": "scm-sdk", "version": "0.1.0", "registry": "crates.io",
        "archiveSha256": ARCHIVE_SHA, "archiveBytes": len(content),
        "sourceCommit": COMMIT, "vcs": vcs,
        "runnerSha256": hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "runnerSource": pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),
        "archiveInspectorSha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (ROOT / "scripts/check-package.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "publicConsumerSourceSha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (ROOT / "contracts/native-probes/src/main.rs").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "checks": [], "passed": False,
        "limitations": [
            "Executes the downloaded, checksum-verified published archive on the recorded native host only.",
            "Examples are compiled without contacting services; no additional live acceptance is established.",
            "The external public consumer source comes from the frozen capability inventory in this checkout.",
            "No registry publication, tag creation, or remote CI execution is performed by this check.",
        ],
    }

    def preserve():
        OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
        OUTPUT.chmod(0o600)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="scm-sdk-registry-execution-") as temporary:
        directory = pathlib.Path(temporary)
        extracted = directory / "scm-sdk"
        extracted.mkdir()
        checks.extract_archive(files, extracted)
        consumer = directory / "consumer"
        (consumer / "src").mkdir(parents=True)
        original = ROOT / "contracts/native-probes"
        manifest = (original / "Cargo.toml").read_text().replace(
            'path = "../../crates/scm-sdk"', 'path = "../scm-sdk"')
        if 'path = "../scm-sdk"' not in manifest:
            raise ValueError("External consumer adapter is missing")
        (consumer / "Cargo.toml").write_text(manifest)
        shutil.copyfile(original / "Cargo.lock", consumer / "Cargo.lock")
        shutil.copyfile(original / "src/main.rs", consumer / "src/main.rs")
        for toolchain in ("1.89.0", "1.99.0"):
            version = subprocess.check_output([str(rustc), "+" + toolchain, "-vV"],
                                              env=environment, text=True)
            host = next(line[6:] for line in version.splitlines() if line.startswith("host: "))
            if environment.get("CARGO_BUILD_TARGET", host) != host:
                raise ValueError("Published archive must execute on the native compiler host")
            for working, arguments in [
                (extracted, ["test", "--lib", "--no-default-features"]),
                (extracted, ["test", "--lib", "--all-features"]),
                (extracted, ["check", "--examples", "--all-features"]),
                (extracted, ["test", "--doc", "--all-features"]),
                (consumer, ["run"]),
            ]:
                command = [str(cargo), "+" + toolchain, *arguments,
                           "--locked", "--offline", "--target", host]
                started = time.monotonic()
                completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=working, env=environment,
                                           text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
                record = {"command": command, "cwd": str(working), "toolchain": toolchain,
                          "rustcVersion": version, "hostTarget": host,
                          "exitCode": completed.returncode,
                          "durationSeconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
                          "stdout": completed.stdout, "stderr": completed.stderr}
                report["checks"].append(record)
                preserve()
                print(json.dumps({"toolchain": toolchain, "command": arguments,
                                  "exitCode": completed.returncode}), flush=True)
                if completed.returncode:
                    return 1
    report["archiveUnchanged"] = hashlib.sha256(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == ARCHIVE_SHA
    report["passed"] = report["archiveUnchanged"] and len(report["checks"]) == 10
    preserve()
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "receipt": str(OUTPUT)}), flush=True)
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
